VA rescinds most telework, remote work policies for employees that still have them

status_summary: VA announced on 2025-02-03 that it would end most telework and remote work agreements in phases, beginning with political appointees, senior executives and equivalents by 2025-02-24, with exceptions for disability, military spouses and other cases. A later VA schedule, reported without a printed date, extended the end of telework to bargaining and non-bargaining employees within 50 miles of federal office space by 2025-05-05 and to more distant employees by 2025-07-28. The policy followed a presidential memorandum on return to in-person work dated 2025-01-20.

timeline.event: Presidential memorandum on return to in-person work for federal employees, published in the Federal Register on 2025-01-28.
VA announced that telework agreements would end for political appointees and senior executives by 2025-02-24, with later dates for other employees.

title: Review hybrid and remote work at VA headquarters and favor in-person presence
uncertainties: The Federal News Network article prints no date to the reader; its URL places it in February 2025, so it is used as a source but not as a dated timeline event. Its schedule (May 5 and July 28) differs from the Federal Times report (April 28 for non-bargaining employees within 50 miles); the later dates are not used in the timeline. The Mandate asks for a review of where remote work is necessary, and VA's broad end of telework goes further than a review. Actual headquarters attendance by the Secretary and staff in 2026 was not verified.
